TitleJP: 月夜　作句　特別な
TitleTH: เล่นไฮกุกลางแสงจันทร์ที่แสนพิเศษ
TitleTW: 月夜　作句　特別的
DescJP: チセは公民館に展示する俳句を作るために、先生と一緒に市内を回って着想を得ようとする。なかなか腑に落ちないチセだったが、先生との楽しい一日を振り返りながら心を込めた俳句を詠むことに成功する。
DescKR: 치세는 홍보관에 출품할 하이쿠를 짓기 위해 시내를 돌며 여러 가지 시상을 떠올린다. 치세는 좀처럼 좋은 시상을 떠올리지 못하지만, 선생님과의 즐거운 하루를 되새기며 하이쿠를 짓는다.
DescEN: Chise wanders the city in search of inspiration for a haiku she has to submit to the promotional hall. Inspiration doesn't strike easily, but she writes a haiku based on the fun day she had with Sensei.
DescTH:
ชิเซะใช้เวลาเดินเที่ยวเล่นในเมืองเพื่อหาแรงบัลดาลใจในการคิด
แพทเทิร์นไฮกุแบบต่างๆ เพื่อนำไปจัดแสดงในโถงประชาสัมพันธ์
แต่เธอก็ไม่ได้แรงบัลดาลใจใหม่ๆ เช่นเคย วันนี้เธอจึงไปใช้เวลา
กับคุณครูอย่างสนุกสนานและนั่งเล่นไฮกุ
DescTW: 知世為了做出能在宣傳館展出的俳句，在市區裡遊走思索各種作詩的靈感。知世想不到什麼好靈感，不過還是反覆回味和老師度過的愉快的一天做了俳句。

DialogEN.Text: After receiving a text, I headed to the park, where I found Chise.
[s] "...Chise? What are you doing in the grass?"

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: I'm not Chise right now, Sensei.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: I am now a cat in the grass.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: It's a way to gain a new perspective.
[s] "And why are you a cat all of a sudden?"

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: I need to find inspiration for a poem.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: I need to make a haiku.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: Yup. Inspiration. A little something like this.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: Yup. Inspiration. A little something like this.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: I want to create a haiku that really moves the heart.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: The deadline isn't too far away.
After listening to Chise and really pondering her words, I started to understand what she meant.
[ns3] "So, as a promotional activity for the Yin-Yang Club..."
[ns4] "...you need a haiku to perform in the promotional hall?"

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: I need to recite a haiku.
[s] "I see, so your Yin-Yang Club is in charge of that."

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: My head is empty... I can't think of anything.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: I need help today. So that I can come up with a good poem.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: Then, in honor of having met you, Sensei...

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: I shall try to explain my feelings of becoming a cat through haiku.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: I feel like I can come up with something better if you hang around a little longer.
[s] "Yeah, there must be a lot of frogs."

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: Mister Frog is calling me. Sensei.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: Mister Frog gave me an idea.
the far side of a river

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: How is it? Do you think the frogs will like it?

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: The convenience store is so colorful.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: I might come up with something here.
[s] "Hmm, there isn't much to be inspired by here..."
[s6] "If you ask me, it's great, Chise."
I went from place to place all day long with Chise.
She came up with several haiku.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: No. Something is still missing, Sensei.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: I need something...something that moves the heart...
Chise, unsatisfied, kept shaking her head.
And then the sun went down.
[ns7] "We've done a lot of walking today."
[ns8] "So, did you come up with any good ideas?"

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: I came up with a lot of ideas walking around with you.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: But everything seems to be lacking.
[s] "But at least it was a fun day."
[s9] "I got to listen to all your haiku."
[s10] "And I was able to have a fun walk."

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: Poof! It just came to me.

DialogEN.Name: Chise
DialogEN.Text: I must return for one more haiku.
I don't know how long I chased after Chise. She kept running around, claiming to have thought of something.
― And that made me realize something.[wa:1280]
― I want to write a haiku...[wa:4460]
― I think I can keep writing meaningful haiku like this[wa:2300]
― as long as I'm with you, Sensei.
[ns] "Huh? Over there... You mean the moon?"
[ns] "Some things are beautiful even without a haiku to capture them."
I sat down with Chise, and we spent some time watching the moon together.
